# EZ-Tree source

Source: https://github.com/dgreenheck/ez-tree at dcf309bd86bd521083d9c70f01f2de45fdc7c457. MIT License by Daniel Greenheck; see LICENSE. Texture rights are documented in TEXTURE-LICENSE.md. Relative import extensions were added, and three presets were inlined for native ESM. Runtime scene uses locally generated immutable geometry; generation code is retained for reproducibility in scripts/build-ez-trees.mjs.
